title.narrative: 132kV Mirama-Kabale Transmission Line and Distribution Project

description.narrative:
The project aims at providing sustainable electricity supply to the Southwest, North and Northeast of Uganda through the construction of a new transmission line from Mirama to Kabale and a new Substation at Kabale; the extension of the Mirama Substation and the construction of new distribution network.
The expected outcomes are: i. To provide 19,152 new customers (that includes 12 factories; 24 Health Facilities; 60 schools; 27 trading centres and 25 Agricultural Facilities) in 121 villages in the project area. ii. Improve quality of electricity supply in the project area from an average of 3 hours/day (2013) to 20 hours/day (2023).
